title.zh: 参数实验台：使用与学习

goal.zh: 亲自使用模型、用核验样本改变参数，再用新输入检查使用过程，区分训练与推理。
goal.en: Use a model, change its parameter with a verified example, then try a new input and distinguish training from inference.

explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。
explanation.en: Training uses existing examples to adjust model parameters so the model learns patterns in data. Good training performance does not guarantee good performance on new data; independent validation is needed.

example.zh: 本题简化模型：输出=参数×输入，初始参数2。核验样本输入2、真实结果8。使用模型不改变参数；学习按钮按本题样本拟合参数。一次拟合演练不代表所有模型都这样训练。
example.en: Toy model: output = parameter × input, initially parameter 2. A verified example has input 2 and outcome 8. Using the model leaves the parameter unchanged; the learning button fits this example. This one-step exercise is not a universal training process.

instructions.zh: 先用初始模型试输入；再用核验样本学习；换个输入使用学后的模型；根据实际记录判断哪次改变了参数。
instructions.en: Try the initial model, learn from the verified example, use the fitted model on a different input, then judge which recorded operation changed parameters.

explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。

title.en: On-call coverage, alerts, rollback, and change

explanation.zh: 生产交接要明确负责人、运行手册、监测、故障接手、回退、版本变更与持续资料维护。模型文件交付只是其中一部分。
explanation.en: Production handover must specify owners, runbooks, monitoring, incident handover, rollback, version changes, and ongoing maintenance of source material. Delivery of model files is only one part.

example.zh: 通过本清单不证明全部生产就绪或法律合规；权限、安全、容量和业务验证仍需相应证据。应按组织预案处置真实事件，不从演练推出所有事故固定顺序。
example.en: Passing this checklist proves neither complete production readiness nor legal compliance. Permissions, security, capacity, and business validation need their own evidence. Real incidents follow organizational response plans, not a universal sequence inferred from this rehearsal.

explanation.zh: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。
explanation.en: Specify when people review, when automated actions stop, when escalation occurs, and who takes over. Confident wording from a model cannot replace formal authorization.

evidence.quote: Mechanisms are in place and applied, and responsibilities are assigned and understood, to supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems that demonstrate performance or outcomes inconsistent with intended use.

explanation.en: Those responsible for execution perform the work; those ultimately accountable own the decisions and outcomes. Business, technology, data, and oversight functions need clear collaboration and authority boundaries so that broad participation does not leave decisions unowned.

goal.zh: 逐项核对结论是否被当前、相关资料支持，保留未知条件并请求复核。
goal.en: Check each claim against current relevant material, preserve unknown conditions, and request review.

instructions.zh: 打开版本登记与相关政策，逐项判断结论并选择依据。注意未拆封、收货7天内、提出申请与另行批准的区别。未知损坏情形保留未知，不把缺材料当成禁止。
instructions.en: Open the version register and relevant policy, then judge each claim and choose its evidence. Preserve unopened, within 7 days of receipt, submission versus separate approval. Keep unstated damaged-item handling unknown; absent material does not mean prohibition.

boundary.zh: 缺材料不等于证明现实政策禁止退款；版本、条件与批准权限均须单独核对，引用匹配也不保证来源本身真实。
boundary.en: Missing material does not prove a real policy forbids refunds. Check version, conditions, and approval authority separately; matching a citation does not guarantee the source itself is true.

text.zh: 版本登记：v2为现行；v1已失效，仅允许用v2回答当前申请条件。
text.en: Version register: v2 active, v1 retired; only v2 may answer current submission conditions.

text.zh: 旧v1：可在14天内提出申请。此版本已失效。
text.en: Retired v1: requests may be submitted within 14 days.

text.zh: 现行v2演练政策：未拆封商品可在收货7天内提出退款申请；批准与否另需审核。没有提供已拆封损坏商品的处理条款。
text.en: Active v2 exercise policy: unopened items may be submitted for refund review within 7 days of receipt; approval requires separate review. No handling clause is provided for opened damaged items.

text.zh: 未拆封商品可在收货7天内提出申请。
text.en: An unopened item may be submitted within 7 days of receipt.

feedback.zh: v2支持完整条件：未拆封、收货7天内、提出申请；不意味着自动批准。
feedback.en: v2 supports the full conditions: unopened, within 7 days of receipt, submission; not automatic approval.

text.zh: 所有商品7天内一定获批退款。
text.en: Every item is guaranteed approval within 7 days.

feedback.zh: v2明确需要另行审核，且限定未拆封；保证全部批准与条款冲突。
feedback.en: v2 explicitly requires separate review and limits the clause to unopened items; universal guaranteed approval contradicts it.

text.zh: 当前申请期限仍是14天。
text.en: The current submission window is still 14 days.

feedback.zh: v1旧链接不证明当前期限；现行v2是7天条件。
feedback.en: A retired v1 link does not support the current window; active v2 states the 7-day condition.

text.zh: 已拆封且损坏的商品一定能退款。
text.en: An opened damaged item is guaranteed a refund.

feedback.zh: 材料未给此情形条款；既不能保证退款，也不能推出一律禁止，应升级复核。
feedback.en: No clause covers that case; neither guaranteed refund nor universal prohibition follows. Escalate for review.

explanation.zh: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。
explanation.en: Hallucinations are plausible but incorrect or unsupported content. Check the relevance, citation support, and version of source material; preserve uncertainty about important unknowns and escalate for review.

example.zh: 缺材料不等于证明现实政策禁止退款；版本、条件与批准权限均须单独核对，引用匹配也不保证来源本身真实。
example.en: Missing material does not prove a real policy forbids refunds. Check version, conditions, and approval authority separately; matching a citation does not guarantee the source itself is true.

explanation.zh: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。
explanation.en: Hallucinations may appear as plausible but unsupported content. Manage the risk through source verification, data-quality checks, monitoring, and human review where needed.

goal.zh: 找出新部门与试点的数据、支持和负载差异，限定迁移结论并保留暂停点。
goal.en: Identify data, support, and load differences between pilot and new department, limit transfer claims, and preserve pause points.

instructions.zh: 打开试点、新部门与新增资料证据，分别判断迁移范围和新证据改变了什么。保留原试点的有效范围，一项修好不等于所有条件验证。
instructions.en: Open pilot, new-department and update evidence; judge rollout scope and what the new evidence changes. Preserve the pilot’s supported scope; fixing one condition does not verify all conditions.

boundary.zh: 这是题设下的受控推广判断，不是每次推广都必须同一流程；无新证据不自动升级结论，一项修好不代表其他条件也已验证。
boundary.en: This is a controlled-rollout judgment under the stated facts, not a mandatory workflow for every rollout. Conclusions do not upgrade without evidence, and fixing one condition does not validate the others.

text.zh: 志愿者试点在已覆盖资料、已演练支持和经验证试点负载下通过检查；其结论仅限这些条件。
text.en: The volunteer pilot passed checks with covered material, rehearsed support and validated pilot load; its results are limited to those conditions.

text.zh: 新部门配置相同；当地流程资料缺失，接手人员未训练，新负载未验证。
text.en: The new department uses the same configuration; local material is missing, responders are untrained and new load is unvalidated.

text.zh: 新增记录仅确认取得授权的本地流程资料并完成对应内容核验；没有新增接手演练或负载测试证据。
text.en: New record confirms only authorized local material and corresponding content checks; no new handover rehearsal or load-test evidence exists.

text.zh: 当前应暂停新部门推广范围，补本地资料、接手演练与负载验证。
text.en: Pause the new department rollout scope and obtain local material, handover rehearsal and load validation.

feedback.zh: 暂停限于未满足条件的新部门；需要补三类迁移验证。
feedback.en: Pause applies to the new department with unmet conditions; three transfer checks are needed.

text.zh: 新部门缺资料，证明原试点全部结论都是错的。
text.en: Missing new-department material proves every original pilot result false.

feedback.zh: 试点仍在原验证条件下成立；新部门差异限制外推，不能抹掉已有证据。
feedback.en: The pilot remains supported under its tested conditions; new-department differences limit transfer and do not erase existing evidence.

text.zh: 取得新资料后，新部门接手和负载条件也已经全部验证。
text.en: After obtaining local material, handover and load conditions are also fully verified.

feedback.zh: 新记录明确只补资料核验，接手与负载仍缺证据，不能自动升级全部结论。
feedback.en: The new record covers only material checks; handover and load still lack evidence, so overall readiness cannot automatically upgrade.

text.zh: 补齐验证后，新部门一定永远不会失败。
text.en: After validation, the new department can never fail.

feedback.zh: 有限条件验证不能证明未来绝不失败，应保留监测与暂停点。
feedback.en: Validation under limited conditions cannot prove no future failures; retain monitoring and pause points.

title.zh: 试点代表性与迁移条件

explanation.zh: 试点结果受参与者、数据和支持条件影响。扩展前检查新部门任务差异、资源、成本与用户能力，分批验证并保留暂停点。
explanation.en: Pilot results depend on participants, data, and support conditions. Before expansion, examine differences in new departments' tasks, resources, costs, and user capabilities; validate in batches and retain pause points.

example.zh: 这是题设下的受控推广判断，不是每次推广都必须同一流程；无新证据不自动升级结论，一项修好不代表其他条件也已验证。

explanation.zh: 准备度是能否开展并维持特定用途的条件。分别检查领导共识、数据可用性、文化与技能、基础设施和治理，记录证据而非只填写自评分。
explanation.en: Readiness consists of the conditions needed to begin and sustain a particular use. Separately examine leadership alignment, data availability, culture and skills, infrastructure, and governance; record evidence rather than just self-assessment scores.
